about: Random seating and balancing prompts (#120; decision 0204). A new player may be given any free seat at the tables with the fewest players, and seating picks one of those at random; with every seat taken the player is an alternate (no seats). Tables balance by moves: while the fullest table has two or more players than the emptiest, one player moves from the fullest to the emptiest, the lowest-numbered table of each on a tie. A bust finishes in the place of the runs (entries and re-entries not refunded) less where it stands among the busts, plus one: the first out of 58 is 58th. Seats are written 'table/seat'; counts list each table's players in table order; moves are written 'from>to'.

cases.description: An empty room of two 3-seat tables: every seat of both.
Table 1 has a player: only table 2's seats.
Level tables again: the free seats of both.
Only a table with a free seat counts: table 2 is full, so table 1's last seat.
Every seat taken: the player is an alternate.
The design prompt's room: 8, 8, 8 and 7 is balanced.
A bust leaves 9, 9 and 6: two moves to the third table.
Two players apart is one move.
A table emptied by busts takes the moves.
The first out of 58 runs finishes 58th.
The 27th bust of 58 runs finishes 32nd, as 31 are left.
The last bust of the night is second; the winner never busts.
A late entry adds a run: the first bust of 59 is 59th, so places never repeat.
A bust beyond the runs is refused.
